urban_footprint_indicators.interpretation: Spatial overlap with positive-value GHSL cells. Not independently verified flooded buildings or infrastructure.

economic_activity_context.interpretation: Regional nighttime-light activity context. Not a direct measurement of flood-related economic loss.

assessment_conclusion.reason: Independent flood reference data and verified asset exposure values are required before operational risk classification.

limitations: SAR-derived flood candidates require independent validation.
GHSL positive-value overlap is not confirmed building exposure.
